project.name: netsec.github.io
project.description: Official website and open community directory of COST Action CA24154, Networking European Security Knowledge (NetSec): a dependency-light static GitHub Pages site with hand-authored HTML pages (English, French and German), shared CSS/JS, and a Python scripts/ automation layer that syncs and validates data via extensive GitHub Actions workflows.

nodes.name: sync-cost.py
nodes.summary: Sync helper that scrapes https://www.cost.eu/actions/CA24154/ to keep five data surfaces in step: the home-page WG_MAP embedded in all three locale index files, per-bio wgs and leadership fields in data/bios.json, data/wg.json, and data/mc-members.json plus the About-page MC statistics.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses BeautifulSoup to scrape a static HTML page and reconciles per-Working-Group membership changes with an observation clock stored in data/cost-wg-state.json rather than blindly overwriting form-submitted data.

nodes.name: norm
nodes.summary: Normalises a display name (removes salutation, diacritics, lowercases) for matching against cost.eu scraped rows.

nodes.name: titlecase_name
nodes.summary: Converts a scraped name into consistent title-case for display, respecting existing capitalisation of particles.

nodes.name: fetch_wg_map
nodes.summary: Parses cost.eu's Membership table from the fetched HTML into a {normalised-name: [Working Group numbers]} map.

nodes.name: rewrite_wg_map
nodes.summary: Rewrites the embedded WG_MAP literal in all three locale index.html files with the freshly scraped map so the WG chips stay consistent across EN, FR, and DE.

nodes.name: report_wg
nodes.summary: Prints a human-readable report of WG_MAP changes between the old and new scraped states.

nodes.name: _load_wg_state
nodes.summary: Loads the per-member Working Group observation-clock state from data/cost-wg-state.json used to reconcile WG changes across sources.

nodes.name: reconcile_wgs
nodes.summary: Reconciles each member's Working Group set between the freshly scraped cost.eu map and the form-submitted bios.json data, applying additions, holding form-side removals with a flag, and tracking pending catch-ups via the observation-clock state.

nodes.name: _unescape_html
nodes.summary: Unescapes HTML entities in a scraped text fragment.

nodes.name: extract_leadership
nodes.summary: Extracts Leadership and Additional-Roles table entries from the scraped cost.eu HTML into structured role records.

nodes.name: _make_seed_entry
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal placeholder bio entry for a leadership-role holder who has no existing bios.json record yet.

nodes.name: wg_leadership_from_roles
nodes.summary: Derives the per-Working-Group lead/co-lead mapping from the extracted leadership role records.

nodes.name: apply_leadership
nodes.summary: Applies the scraped leadership roles onto bios.json member records, enforcing exactly one current holder per role and creating seed entries for holders with no existing bio.

nodes.name: fetch_members
nodes.summary: Parses the cost.eu Membership table into a list of member records with name and Working Group affiliations.

nodes.name: build_wg_json
nodes.summary: Builds the data/wg.json structure: for each Working Group, its lead, co-lead, directory members, and a count of members without a bio yet.

nodes.name: fetch_mc
nodes.summary: Parses the cost.eu Management Committee table into structured MC representative records (name, country, ISO code).

nodes.name: apply_mc_roles
nodes.summary: Applies MC representative role and country data onto matching bios.json member records using name/country matching.

nodes.name: build_mc_json
nodes.summary: Builds the data/mc-members.json roster structure from the scraped Management Committee records.

nodes.name: apply_stats
nodes.summary: Updates the MC-count and country-count data-cost-stat spans on the About page and press kit across locales to match the freshly scraped MC roster.

nodes.name: check_country_grid
nodes.summary: Checks the hand-authored MC country grid on about.html against the scraped MC roster and reports drift without rewriting the curated markup.

nodes.name: restamp_index_i18n
nodes.summary: Restamps cache-busting version hashes on the locale index files after the WG_MAP rewrite.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point orchestrating the full cost.eu sync: fetches the page once, then updates WG_MAP, per-bio WGs and leadership, wg.json, mc-members.json, and site statistics in sequence.

nodes.name: _directory_common.py
nodes.summary: Shared, dependency-free name-identity helpers (slugify and name_key) used by both sync-bios.py and sync-cost.py, extracted after the two scripts' forked copies drifted and mis-keyed apostrophe surnames like "Silvia D'Amato".
nodes.languageNotes: Intentionally imports only re and unicodedata so it can be imported from any sync script without dragging in requests, avoiding conditional-stub workarounds in dependent scripts.

nodes.name: slugify
nodes.summary: Converts a person's name into a stable slug id, stripping diacritics, honorific titles, and apostrophes before collapsing remaining non-alphanumerics to hyphens so results match existing seed ids.

nodes.name: name_key
nodes.summary: Reduces a name to a lowercased (first_token, last_token) tuple for fallback dedup matching, dropping titles, apostrophes, post-nominals, and nobiliary particles.

nodes.name: sync-bios.py
nodes.summary: Sync helper that refreshes data/bios.json from the NetSec member bios Google Form's linked Google Sheet, downloading and resizing headshots, merging new submissions with prior directory state, and emitting a human-readable diff plus PR body for the automated sync workflow.
nodes.languageNotes: Large single-file script (2284 lines, 40 top-level functions) with no classes, organised as a linear pipeline: fetch CSV, normalise each field, merge with prior JSON, classify the diff, and render a PR summary.

nodes.name: norm_email
nodes.summary: Normalises an email address by trimming and lowercasing for stable comparison keys.

nodes.name: country_key
nodes.summary: Normalises a country string into a lowercase comparison key used for fallback member matching.

nodes.name: parse_timestamp
nodes.summary: Parses a raw form timestamp string into a Unix epoch value, trying multiple known datetime formats.

nodes.name: parse_wgs
nodes.summary: Extracts and sorts numeric Working Group identifiers from a raw form field value.

nodes.name: parse_mentorship
nodes.summary: Interprets a raw mentorship-programme form answer into a normalised list of mentorship role flags (mentor/mentee).

nodes.name: parse_stsm_hosting
nodes.summary: Interprets a raw STSM (Short-Term Scientific Mission) hosting-willingness form answer into normalised boolean-style flags.

nodes.name: parse_keywords
nodes.summary: Splits a raw free-text keywords field into a cleaned list of individual keyword strings.

nodes.name: normalise_title
nodes.summary: Extracts and normalises a leading honorific title (Prof, Dr, Mr, etc.) from a person's raw name string.

nodes.name: build_name
nodes.summary: Assembles a member's display name and title from the raw form row, handling both current and legacy name columns.

nodes.name: load_keyword_aliases
nodes.summary: Loads the keyword acronym/alias/spelling vocabulary from the alias config file used to normalise research keywords.

nodes.name: load_keyword_themes
nodes.summary: Loads the keyword-to-theme grouping map from the alias config file, used to suggest thematic categorisation of keywords.

nodes.name: load_affiliation_aliases
nodes.summary: Loads the affiliation-name alias map used to normalise institution names to a canonical form.

nodes.name: load_region_vocab
nodes.summary: Loads the controlled vocabulary of valid geographic region names used to validate and normalise a member's declared regions.

nodes.name: parse_regions
nodes.summary: Parses a raw region form field against the controlled region vocabulary, returning a deduplicated sorted list of matched regions.

nodes.name: normalise_keyword
nodes.summary: Normalises a single raw keyword string using the acronym, alias, and spelling maps, applying consistent casing rules.

nodes.name: normalise_affiliation
nodes.summary: Normalises a raw affiliation/institution string by cleaning whitespace and punctuation and applying the affiliation alias map.

nodes.name: _levenshtein
nodes.summary: Computes the Levenshtein edit distance between two strings, used to flag likely-typo alias candidates.

nodes.name: flag_alias_candidates
nodes.summary: Scans aggregated keyword usage against the existing alias map and prints suggestions for near-duplicate keywords that may need a new alias entry.

nodes.name: normalize_orcid
nodes.summary: Normalises a raw ORCID input (URL or bare id) into the canonical ORCID identifier format.

nodes.name: normalise_url
nodes.summary: Normalises a raw URL form field, ensuring a proper scheme prefix and trimming whitespace.

nodes.name: normalise_bluesky
nodes.summary: Normalises a raw Bluesky handle or profile URL into a consistent handle string.

nodes.name: drive_file_id
nodes.summary: Extracts a Google Drive file id from a shared Drive URL for use in a direct-download request.

nodes.name: download_photo
nodes.summary: Downloads a member's headshot from a Google Drive or HTTPS URL, resizes it to a maximum width using Pillow when available, and writes it to assets/images/people, skipping the write if the content hash matches the prior file.

nodes.name: ensure_people_webp
nodes.summary: Ensures every non-webp photo in the people asset directory has a corresponding up-to-date .webp sibling, generating one via Pillow when missing or stale.

nodes.name: resolve_prior_entry
nodes.summary: Resolves the prior directory entry matching a new form submission, trying email, then slug, then name/country fallback keys in order.

nodes.name: strip_bio_chrome
nodes.summary: Removes a redundant leading line (e.g. a repeated name/title) from a free-text bio before storing it.

nodes.name: row_to_member
nodes.summary: Converts a single validated CSV form row into a fully normalised member record, orchestrating name building, slugging, photo download, and every field normaliser, and recording any link rewrites for the PR review flags.

nodes.name: fill_country_code
nodes.summary: Fills in a member's ISO country code from the country name using the COUNTRY_TO_CODE lookup table.

nodes.name: load_mc_lookup
nodes.summary: Loads the Management Committee member lookup file, keyed by slug, for cross-referencing MC role assignment.

nodes.name: apply_mc_role
nodes.summary: Applies the Management Committee representative role and country to a member record when the member is found in the MC lookup.

nodes.name: load_founding_slugs
nodes.summary: Loads the set of member slugs flagged as founding contributors from the founding-members config file.

nodes.name: apply_founding_flag
nodes.summary: Marks or clears a member record's founding-contributor flag based on membership in the founding slugs set.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges freshly parsed form entries into the prior full directory state, preferring the newer submission by timestamp per matched identity while preserving leadership roles and ordering, and applying MC and founding-flag enrichment.

nodes.name: diff_summary
nodes.summary: Computes a simple textual diff summary between the old and new member lists for logging purposes.

nodes.name: classify_diff
nodes.summary: Classifies the differences between old and new member lists into added, updated, and removed buckets, incorporating whether any photos changed, for use in the PR title and body generation.

nodes.name: render_pr_title
nodes.summary: Renders a concise, human-readable pull request title summarising the classified diff for the automated sync PR.

nodes.name: suggest_theme
nodes.summary: Suggests a thematic category for an uncategorised keyword by comparing it against the loaded keyword-theme map.

nodes.name: render_pr_body_overview
nodes.summary: Renders the full markdown body of the automated sync pull request, including added/updated/removed member sections, uncategorised keyword suggestions, and link-rewrite review flags.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point orchestrating the full bios sync: reads config, fetches the CSV, validates and converts rows, merges with prior data, writes bios.json only on substantive change, and emits the diff summary and PR body.

nodes.name: _emit_pr_summary
nodes.summary: Writes the PR title and body to the environment/output mechanism consumed by the GitHub Actions workflow that opens the automated sync pull request.

nodes.name: _pycheck.yml
nodes.summary: Reusable workflow_call job that checks out the repo, sets up Python 3.12, and runs a single check command; centralises the SHA-pinned checkout + setup-python steps shared by the single-command drift/lint workflows (i18n, calendar, news, CSS collisions, external-link arrows, SEO asset check, brand lint).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GitHub Actions workflow_call to share boilerplate across seven caller workflows so a Dependabot action bump touches one file.

nodes.name: autopr-token-health.yml
nodes.summary: Weekly probe of the AUTOPR_TOKEN fine-grained PAT's validity and expiry window, opening or refreshing a tracking issue when the token is missing, rejected, or expiring within 10 days so the six auto-PR sync workflows never silently fall back to GITHUB_TOKEN unnoticed.

nodes.name: branch-sweep.yml
nodes.summary: Daily job that archives (via a lightweight tag) and deletes stale unmerged branches with no open PR and no recent commits, keeping the branch list signal-only while preserving history.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses actions/github-script inline JS to page through branches and PRs via the GitHub REST API.

nodes.name: brand-lint.yml
nodes.summary: PR-triggered lint that calls the reusable _pycheck workflow to run scripts/check-brand.py, failing if manifest.webmanifest, site.css tokens, or JSON-LD logos drift from data/brand.json.

nodes.name: calendar-drift.yml
nodes.summary: PR-triggered drift gate that calls the reusable _pycheck workflow to run scripts/build-calendar.py --check, ensuring calendar.ics and per-event .ics files stay in sync with data/events.json.

nodes.name: codeql-dependabot-shim.yml
nodes.summary: Posts success status for the three required CodeQL analyze contexts on Dependabot PRs only, working around CodeQL default setup never analysing Dependabot PRs so those PRs aren't blocked forever on checks that never arrive.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pull_request_target for a writable token since Dependabot's default pull_request token is read-only; posts commit statuses without checking out PR code.

nodes.name: css-class-collisions.yml
nodes.summary: PR-triggered lint that calls the reusable _pycheck workflow to run scripts/check-css-class-collisions.py, catching CSS class names reused far apart in site.css for unrelated feature areas.

nodes.name: data-shape-check.yml
nodes.summary: PR-triggered gate for synced data files that validates structural invariants (scripts/check-data-shape.py), smoke-renders key pages headlessly (scripts/check-render-smoke.sh), and verifies profile pages, sitemap, directory-index, and OG cards are current, closing the gap left by sync PRs that could otherwise ship a blank page.

nodes.name: external-link-arrows.yml
nodes.summary: PR-triggered lint that calls the reusable _pycheck workflow to run scripts/check-external-link-arrows.py, flagging external links with a redundant manual arrow glyph alongside the CSS auto-injected icon.

nodes.name: i18n-drift.yml
nodes.summary: PR-triggered translation drift gate that calls the reusable _pycheck workflow to run scripts/check-i18n-drift.py, failing when an English page changed since its FR/DE translation was stamped.

nodes.name: issue-lifecycle-comment.yml
nodes.summary: Posts a standard message when a needs-info, duplicate, wontfix, or stale label lands on an issue, automating the maintainer's routine copy-paste replies.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses actions/github-script inline JS with a label-to-message lookup table; skips bot-applied labels to avoid comment loops.

nodes.name: issue-sweep.yml
nodes.summary: Daily job enforcing three backlog timeouts: closes needs-info issues with no human comment in 14 days, labels stale issues with no activity in 60 days, and closes stale issues after another 14 quiet days.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses actions/github-script inline JS with paginated issue listing and a helper to find the last non-bot human comment date.

nodes.name: launch-qa-link-check.yml
nodes.summary: Runs scripts/check-links.sh on PRs touching HTML and weekly on main to catch broken internal and external links, plus scripts/check-a11y-statement-date.py to flag an overdue accessibility statement review.

nodes.name: lighthouse.yml
nodes.summary: Serves the static site locally and runs Lighthouse CI against key pages, asserting performance/accessibility/SEO budgets from lighthouserc.json; non-required so a red run signals without blocking merge.

nodes.name: lock-closed-issues.yml
nodes.summary: Daily job that locks closed issues with no activity in the last 14 days to keep drive-by comments off settled threads.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses actions/github-script inline JS paginating closed issues sorted by updated_at ascending.

nodes.name: news-drift.yml
nodes.summary: PR-triggered drift gate that calls the reusable _pycheck workflow to run scripts/build-news-rss.py --check, ensuring news.xml stays in step with data/news.json.

nodes.name: news-publish.yml
nodes.summary: Turns an issue labelled 'news' into a published news item by running scripts/publish-news.py and scripts/build-news-rss.py, then opens an auto-merging PR that closes the source issue.

nodes.name: pages-deploy.yml
nodes.summary: Builds the Pagefind search index via scripts/build-search.sh and deploys the full working tree to GitHub Pages under the custom domain, with a six-hourly scheduled self-heal run to converge the live site when a bot-authored push suppresses the normal deploy trigger.

nodes.name: python-tests.yml
nodes.summary: Required status check running the fully-mocked scripts/ pytest suite on every PR and on pushes to main that touch scripts, pytest.ini, or requirements.txt.

nodes.name: roadmap-progress.yml
nodes.summary: Refreshes data/roadmap-progress.json from the repo's GitHub milestones via scripts/sync-roadmap-progress.py on issue/milestone events and a daily backstop, opening an auto-merging PR only when milestone data actually moved so the public roadmap's progress bars stay accurate without a live API call.

nodes.name: search-drift.yml
nodes.summary: PR-triggered sanity check that builds the Pagefind index via scripts/build-search.sh and verifies each locale indexed at least one page, catching build regressions since the index is no longer committed and is rebuilt at deploy time.

nodes.name: seo-asset-check.yml
nodes.summary: Required status check running scripts/inject-seo.py --check on every PR to catch drifted SEO/JSON-LD blocks or missing cache-bust ?v= asset hashes before merge.

nodes.name: social-bluesky.yml
nodes.summary: Approval-gated social publishing pipeline that previews pending Bluesky/LinkedIn posts via scripts/social-post.py --dry-run, then requires a human reviewer on the 'social' environment before running the live post and committing the dedup ledger update via an auto-merging PR.

nodes.name: spotlight-rotate.yml
nodes.summary: Weekly rotation of the home-page member spotlight via scripts/rotate-spotlight.py with a DST-aware gate job selecting the correct UTC cron for 10:00 Europe/Paris, followed by an ungated Bluesky/LinkedIn post via scripts/social-post.py and an auto-merging PR for data/spotlight.json.

nodes.name: sync-bios.yml
nodes.summary: Daily sync of data/bios.json from the linked Google Form/Sheet via scripts/sync-bios.py, followed by ORCID refresh, OG card regeneration, profile-page rebuild, sitemap and directory-index regeneration, and glossary field-guide rebuild, opening a maintainer-reviewed (not auto-merged) PR on any change.

nodes.name: sync-cost.yml
nodes.summary: Weekly sync of the WG_MAP and per-member WG/leadership data from cost.eu via scripts/sync-cost.py, followed by OG card and profile-page regeneration, opening a maintainer-reviewed PR when the Membership table changed.

nodes.name: sync-indico.yml
nodes.summary: Daily (plus repository_dispatch and manual) sync of data/indico.json from the EISS Indico export API via scripts/sync-indico.py, opening an auto-merging PR with a change summary when the programme substantively changed.

nodes.name: sync-roadmap.yml
nodes.summary: Refreshes the machine-managed [Unreleased] autostamp block in docs/roadmap-2026.md via scripts/sync-roadmap.py whenever CHANGELOG.md changes (plus a weekly backstop), opening an auto-merging PR when the stamp moved.

nodes.name: bug_report.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue-template form for structured bug reports, requiring preflight checkboxes (search existing, single report) and required textareas describing the bug, repro steps, and expected behaviour before submission.

nodes.name: config.yml
nodes.summary: Issue-template chooser configuration that disables blank issues and routes routine questions to the public contact form, FAQ, and Wiki onboarding page instead of a free-form issue.

nodes.name: documentation.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue-template form for reporting documentation gaps or errors, with required preflight checkboxes and textareas describing the affected page and the suggested fix.

nodes.name: enhancement.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue-template form for proposing feature enhancements, with required preflight checkboxes and textareas capturing the requested feature, motivation, and target milestone.

nodes.name: 404.html
nodes.summary: GitHub Pages custom 404 error page providing navigation back into the site with helpful links to key sections.

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Canonical hybrid-format changelog for the NetSec website, documenting every release from v1.0.0 through the current Unreleased section with themed sub-sections and an index of changes per release.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows a strict hybrid format: lede + 2-4 themed sub-sections + canonical Index of changes, self-policed to index-only for patch releases.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Standing project rules read by Claude Code every session, codifying the maintainer's constraints on language, PR workflow, release process, voice, accessibility cadence, milestone tagging, and lessons learned from past incidents.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured as 16 numbered rule sections, each terse by design to minimize per-session context cost.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md

nodes.name: SECURITY.md

nodes.name: bios-source.json
nodes.summary: Configuration for scripts/sync-bios.py: the Google Form/Sheet CSV URL, the photo-folder reference, and the exact Google Sheets column-header mapping the sync script matches against to build member bios.
nodes.languageNotes: No-ops safely when csv_url is empty; column headers must mirror the live Google Form question text exactly or the sync silently stops matching a field.

nodes.name: build-search.sh
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the Pagefind search index into the gitignored /pagefind directory, first generating bio search stubs from data/bios.json, then running pagefind 1.5.2 via npx and stripping its node-compile-cache artifact.
nodes.languageNotes: Pinned to a specific Pagefind version for reproducible per-language page counts across machines and CI; the index is deliberately not committed to avoid content-hash shard conflicts between parallel PRs.

nodes.name: strip_cache
nodes.summary: Removes the node-compile-cache directory that npm/npx sometimes drops inside the Pagefind output path after a build.

nodes.name: check-a11y.sh
nodes.summary: Accessibility CI/local script that serves the repo on a local port and runs pa11y (WCAG 2.1 AA + axe-core, bundled Chromium) against every root-level HTML page, writing a Markdown report to tmp/a11y-report.md and failing on any error-level violation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `python3 -c` rather than a heredoc for the JSON-count pass so piped JSON on stdin isn't consumed by the heredoc, a documented fix for a prior silent bug.

nodes.name: check-links.sh
nodes.summary: Broken-link checker for launch QA: scans every root-level HTML file for internal and external href targets, validates internal file/fragment existence (including directory-page member slugs sourced from data/bios.json and JS-consumed filter hashes), and HEAD/GET-checks external URLs with a curated skip list for auth-gated or bot-blocking hosts.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds a substantial inline Python script (via a heredoc) using concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor at 3 workers to stay under GitHub's unauthenticated rate limits, plus per-host and per-domain-suffix skip lists with dated justification comments.

nodes.name: check-render-smoke.sh
nodes.summary: Headless-Chrome render smoke test that serves the working tree locally and asserts the runtime-rendered pages (essc-2026.html, people.html + fr/de, index.html) actually produce their expected DOM markers, catching data-shape drift the JSON shape lint is too loose to detect.
nodes.languageNotes: Resolves both a working Chrome/Chromium binary and a working python3 by probing several candidate paths, since a wrong-architecture framework python3 can be first on PATH on some macOS setups.

nodes.name: render_count
nodes.summary: Runs headless Chrome with --dump-dom against a served page and counts occurrences of a marker string in the post-JS-rendered DOM.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Wraps render_count with a pass/fail assertion against a minimum expected marker count, printing a check-mark or cross and setting the overall fail flag.

nodes.name: release.sh
nodes.summary: Maintainer release-cutting script: validates SemVer version and title, checks preconditions (on main, clean tree, in sync with origin, tag not already used), promotes CHANGELOG.md's [Unreleased] section to a dated version heading, prints a confirmation prompt with a six-point cross-check reminder for minor/major releases and an open-milestone-issues audit, commits and tags on main, pushes, promotes the public roadmap card via promote-roadmap.py, re-marks FR/DE i18n freshness, and publishes the GitHub Release via gh.
nodes.languageNotes: Supports --dry-run end-to-end via a `run` wrapper that echoes but skips execution; resolves a working python3 across several candidate paths for Apple Silicon compatibility, mirroring the same pattern in build.sh.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Echoes a shell command and executes it via eval, unless the script is running in --dry-run mode, in which case it only prints the command.

nodes.name: step
nodes.summary: Prints a formatted section-header line to mark progress through the release script's stages.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned Python dependency list for the sync scripts (requests, beautifulsoup4, Pillow for headshot re-encoding, PyYAML for indico_patch.py fix-plan files), version-capped by major version for stable CI caching.

nodes.name: guard-main-commit.sh
nodes.summary: PreToolUse(Bash) hook that inspects any git commit command and denies it when the current branch is main or master, enforcing the repo's branch-first PR workflow as a backstop rather than the primary mechanism.
nodes.languageNotes: Fails open on every unexpected condition (parse errors, non-commit commands, unreadable directories) by exiting 0, so the guard cannot itself block unrelated work; it only emits a JSON permissionDecision deny payload when it detects `git commit` while on main/master.

nodes.name: main-guard-flow
nodes.summary: Top-level script body: reads the hook's stdin JSON, extracts the attempted Bash command, resolves the target directory from a leading `cd`, checks the branch there, and emits a deny decision if it's main/master.

nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Committed, shared Claude Code settings for the repo that wires the guard-main-commit.sh script as a PreToolUse hook on Bash tool calls, ensuring commits are blocked on main across all sessions.

nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Git attributes file that sets a union merge strategy for CHANGELOG.md so parallel PRs appending bullets under [Unreleased] merge without conflicts, deliberately scoped away from HTML/i18n files where a silent merge would corrupt output.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: Dependabot configuration watching GitHub Actions used across .github/workflows (grouped by actions/* platform patterns, SHA-pin hygiene) and Python dependencies in scripts/requirements.txt on a weekly Monday cadence, both auto-mergeable once CI passes.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore-pattern configuration for the Understand-Anything analysis tool itself, gitignore-style globs (mostly commented-out suggestions) excluding scratch, cache, and generated directories like pagefind/, tmp/, and resolved indico fix-plan JSON from the knowledge-graph scan.

nodes.name: site.css
nodes.summary: The single shared stylesheet for the entire NetSec site, implementing a glassmorphism design system with CSS custom properties for theming, light/dark mode support (both manual toggle via `.dark` class and `prefers-color-scheme` media queries), responsive breakpoints, and dozens of component sections covering navigation, hero, glass cards, working groups, Management Committee listings, events/outputs timelines, roadmap Gantt charts, footer, and reveal-on-scroll animations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a dual dark-mode strategy: a manual `.dark` class toggle (for an explicit user preference control, distinct from the OS-level scheme) layered alongside `@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark)` rules; also includes `@media print` and `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` accessibility accommodations throughout.

nodes.name: essc-programme.js
nodes.summary: Renders the live European Security Conference 2026 programme on essc-2026.html, fetching schedule data from data/indico.json, cross-referencing member bios and an external anthology index, and highlighting the currently live session.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an IIFE module pattern with numerous small render helpers (renderSlot, renderSession, renderContribution) composed into a DOM tree via a lightweight `el()` builder.

nodes.name: formatDate
nodes.summary: Formats an ISO date string into a locale-aware display string for the programme.

nodes.name: buildMemberLookup
nodes.summary: Builds a name-keyed lookup map from the fetched bios.json data so programme entries can be matched to member profiles for hover cards.

nodes.name: renderSession
nodes.summary: Renders a full conference session block including contributions, breaks, and livestream/room badges.

nodes.name: renderNow
nodes.summary: Renders the 'happening now' banner by computing which schedule slots are currently live.

nodes.name: showMemberCard
nodes.summary: Displays a hover card with a member's profile summary when their name is clicked in the programme.

nodes.name: home-events.js
nodes.summary: Renders the upcoming-events widget on the homepage by fetching data/events.json, picking the visitor's locale, and rendering a filterable event list with calendar-add links.

nodes.name: home-news.js
nodes.summary: Renders the news widget on the homepage by fetching data/news.json and rendering the latest locale-appropriate news items.

nodes.name: home-spotlight.js
nodes.summary: Renders the rotating member-spotlight widget on the homepage by combining data/spotlight.json (rotation state) with data/bios.json (member details).

nodes.name: outputs-publications.js
nodes.summary: Renders the publications list on outputs.html by fetching data/publications.json and cross-referencing data/bios.json for author details.

nodes.name: people-directory.js
nodes.summary: The searchable, filterable member directory engine on people.html: fetches data/bios.json, data/spotlight.json, and data/orcid-works.json at runtime, and implements search, keyword/region/working-group filters, compact/panel views, mentorship and STSM filter chips, and a guided tour.
nodes.languageNotes: Very large single-module IIFE (2135 lines) mixing DOM rendering, filter state management, URL hash sync, and card-panel interactions. Filter handlers are scoped to data-* attribute selectors rather than styling classes, per repo convention, to avoid selector collisions between filter chip types.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Core render function that applies all active search and filter criteria to the member list and rebuilds the visible directory cards.

nodes.name: memberPassesFilters
nodes.summary: Determines whether a member record matches the current search query and active filter set (working groups, themes, regions, mentorship, STSM).

nodes.name: openPanel
nodes.summary: Opens the detail panel clone for a selected member card, syncing the URL hash for deep-linking.

nodes.name: setupMentorshipFilter
nodes.summary: Wires the mentorship filter chip's click handler, scoped by a data-mentorship attribute selector to avoid colliding with other pill-styled chips (fix for issue in PR #862).

nodes.name: setupStsmFilter
nodes.summary: Wires the STSM-hosting filter chip's click handler.

nodes.name: startTour
nodes.summary: Launches the guided onboarding tour over the directory UI for first-time visitors.

nodes.name: loadOrcidWorks
nodes.summary: Lazily fetches data/orcid-works.json once and caches it for backfilling member publication lists.

nodes.name: populateCountryFilter
nodes.summary: Builds the country filter dropdown options from the loaded member data.

nodes.name: roadmap-progress.js

tour.title: Project overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand the site's purpose: the official website and open community directory for COST Action CA24154 (NetSec), doubling as the Action's Deliverable D1. It's a dependency-light static GitHub Pages site with no bundler or JS framework.

tour.title: The AI-assisted workflow rulebook
tour.description: CLAUDE.md codifies the maintainer's standing rules for AI-assisted work on this repo: branch-first PRs, the release process, i18n conventions, and CSS-collision lessons learned the hard way. Read this before making any change here.

tour.title: Homepage entry point
tour.description: index.html is the site's front door: hand-authored HTML that loads the shared stylesheet and JS, then reads JSON data files at runtime to populate widgets like events, news, and the member spotlight.

tour.title: Shared frontend layer
tour.description: assets/js/site.js is loaded on every page: theme toggling, navigation, and the dismissible 'What's New' banner. Feature-specific widgets like people-directory.js and essc-programme.js layer on top for individual pages.

tour.title: The member directory: data to page
tour.description: data/bios.json is the authoritative directory of Action members. people-directory.js reads it at runtime to power the searchable/filterable grid on people.html, while build-profile-pages.py statically generates one page per member under people/.

tour.title: Keeping the directory in sync
tour.description: scripts/sync-bios.py reconciles data/bios.json against upstream sources (a Google Form/Sheet) on a weekly cadence, driven by the sync-bios.yml GitHub Actions workflow — one of several scheduled sync pipelines that keep the site's data current without manual upkeep.

tour.title: The live conference programme
tour.description: data/indico.json mirrors an external Indico conference-management instance. scripts/sync-indico.py performs the sync, and assets/js/essc-programme.js renders the live programme on essc-2026.html at runtime.

tour.title: Release automation and SEO
tour.description: scripts/release.sh is the canonical release-cutting tool, calling scripts/inject-seo.py to regenerate sitemap.xml and stamp cache-busting ?v= hashes across every HTML page — a sitewide change that CHANGELOG.md tracks per release.

tour.title: Deep architecture reference
tour.description: For the full data-flow picture (which scripts feed which JSON files, which JS widgets consume them, and how the scheduled GitHub Actions tie it together), docs/architecture.md is the maintainer-facing reference that this tour has only sampled.
